limitations: single released WM and head seed, 16 anchors per task/goal range
labels are demonstrated remaining time, not shortest-path or counterfactual reachability
head updates matched; MIXED performs an extra head forward
TwoRoom execution transform changes cost input, keeps native raw elite statistics; PushT does not clip
training fit and factual-pair RMSE are auxiliary, not control evidence
WM pretraining overlap unknown; public PushT restore does not include full contact memory
PushT native_task_distance is the native 7D norm including velocity and unwrapped angle; it is not pure pixel position distance. Native success uses position and wrapped angle.
interpretation: No robust improvement of learned continuation cost over strong native L2; imagined-domain head training does not show a control advantage. Does not refute goal values or R3.
